requirements.description: Complete event-level analysis inputs beyond the CUSIP/event-date list, including subsequent-event return outcomes, filing-period information, disclosure/recognition and loss measures, controls and the inputs needed for supplementary disclosure and earnings-call analyses. issues.description: The supplied variant contains a README, a two-variable event sample and a supplemental PDF, but no executable program, entry point or complete author-approved manual workflow.

The appendix describes required results using abnormal returns through the next quarterly filing, matched disclosure and recognition samples, quantified and non-quantified events, loss and filing-lag measures, footnote keyword counts, and earnings-call discussion. The supplied CUSIP/event-date sample does not establish a compatible complete analysis input route; the remaining data, construction, sample coverage, software, sequencing and mapping from inputs to results are unspecified. No analysis-only route can be established without executable analysis code and compatible author-prepared analysis inputs.

actions.description: Obtain the complete author-provided workflow and data specification, including a compatible route for all analysis inputs and a map from each main and supplementary result to its producer and input data.
steps: Request the complete executable program set or an approved documented manual replacement, run instructions, required software and version details, and execution logs.

Request a data dictionary and end-to-end stage map specifying how the packaged CUSIP/event-date list is used, how the full subsequent-event analysis sample and disclosure/recognition measures are produced, and where each required analysis input comes from.
